sources: Illustrative only, not surveyed courses. Par 4: 380 m with a 35 m fairway and a 15 m green radius so that driver carries of about 170 to 210 m land on the fairway. Par 3: 160 m (about 175 yd), 30 m fairway and a 12 m green radius, reached by a 7-iron carrying 155 to 165 m on the matched iron swing with the club rolled about 10 degrees closed in the hands. Par 5: 480 m, 35 m fairway, 15 m green radius. Lengths are metres (--hole-length takes the display unit). Colours are chosen for contrast on the fairway green; trace and figure sizes are display choices.
